headline: Shipping Corporation, Nuvama Wealth, and Bharti Hexacom see volume-led price surges
hook: High trading activity drives stock price gains
summary: Shipping Corporation of India, Nuvama Wealth Management, and Bharti Hexacom witnessed significant price increases accompanied by a spike in trading volumes.
